limitations: The 100-request sample is MVP evidence and is not a production capacity guarantee.
The local BGE cost is an allocation estimate based on the declared hardware hourly rate.
Evaluation-only judge cost is reported separately when available and is never assumed to be zero.

selection_rationale.cache: Normal serving may use compatible retrieval caching, while official performance traffic bypasses it so latency and usage remain attributable.
selection_rationale.model: The selected generation model passes the advanced bilingual gate; the source model comparison records its quality, latency, and cost trade-offs.
selection_rationale.reranker: The local cross-encoder improves top-context ordering; the source retrieval comparison records the measured effect and added latency.
selection_rationale.retrieval: Hybrid parent-child retrieval preserves bilingual semantic recall and exact-term matches while returning bounded parent context.
